South America.title: NEW: Caracol Televisión headquarters in Bogotá evacuated over possible attack threat
South America.summary: EFE reports Caracol Televisión, one of Colombia's main broadcasters, evacuated its facilities over an alleged attack plot by illegal armed groups. El Tiempo reports the channel said it adopted all necessary measures, and that Colombia's Ombudsman's Office called the threats grave and asked for them to be clarified. No attack or injuries have been reported.
